svg.title: System I quantum-dot quantum-well architecture
svg.desc: Composition-layer schematic following the paper. Rings communicate sequence only, not particle shape, scale or measured geometry. The source cites tetrahedral CdS; its core-size 3.5 nm/3.2 nm discrepancy remains unresolved. No atomistic interface, phase or exact crystal structure is assigned.
svg.text: Layer-sequence illustration · not to scale · no measured atomic model
